description: Elections Commission - Declare that P. D. Y. Lakmini as a member of the Kesbewa Urban Council
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Kesbewa Urban Council) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with the electoral process for local authorities, including the nomination and declaration of a new council member to fill a vacancy caused by a member ceasing to belong to their political party. This falls squarely under the "Elections Gazettes" category (Type 7) which covers electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations related to local government elections.
